rows.grounds: compound numeral adjective indicating quantities two, three, four, or five
instrumental plural of darbha, the ritual grass blades
compound adjective qualifying the darbha blades as including both root and tip
particle marking an alternative or continuation

items.question: Which quantities and condition of kuśa blades are permitted as alternatives?
premises: Kuśa blades may be used in quantities of two, three, four, or five.
The kuśa blades must include both root and tip.
The particles tu and vā present these specifications as alternatives.
items.inference: The ritual permits darbha blades in sets of two to five, provided they include both root and tip.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of tu alongside vā in marking the alternative is slightly ambiguous.
items.plain_english: Or alternatively, with two, three, four, or five darbha blades that include both root and tip.
